Nora (Docs): Found an edge case for the v1->v2 migration guide: swapping embedding aliases can change vector dims (eg 1024 -> 1536) and silently break downstream indexes. Need a short playbook and banner.
Ibrahim (SDK): Can you include a minimal repro? We'll add a snippet to detect dims.
Nora (Docs): Minimal repro (truncated):
```
POST /v2/embeddings
body: {"model": "alias:embed-stable", "input": "hi"}
response: {"data": [{"embedding": [ ...1536 floats... ]}]}
```
Priya (Product): We should add a migration banner and a tiny recipe: check dims on a sample, reindex if needed, or pin model version.
Ibrahim (SDK): Proposed snippet for docs (language-agnostic):
```
resp = client.embeddings.create(...)
dim = len(resp.data[0].embedding)
if dim != expected_dim:
    raise RuntimeError("embedding size mismatch; pin model or reindex")
```
Alex (Infra): I'll add `vector_dim` to the model catalog API (INF-872) so docs and SDK can surface dims reliably.
Nora (Docs): Plan: add "Embed dimensionality changes" subsection, FAQ bullet, and the truncated example. I'll open a PR and link it here.
docs-bot: created task DOCS-1309 (embed-dim-migration) assigned to @Nora, @Ibrahim, @Alex due in 7 days.
Ibrahim (SDK): I'll add JS/Python examples and a unit test that asserts friendly error text.
Priya (Product): Approve wording once PR is ready. Also add a short UX banner copy: "Verify embedding vector size before switching models; see migration recipe."
Nora (Docs): Great. I'll push the PR draft and ping reviewers. Will also fix two stale links in the embedding guide while editing. :white_check_mark:
